info.title: ff-edge API
info.description: Fantasy football team advisor. Data: Sleeper, nflverse (CC-BY 4.0), FantasyCalc, DynastyProcess.

post.description: Look up a Sleeper user's leagues and teams for the current season (no full sync yet).
Pick your team; syncs the league's rosters, transactions and market values if needed.
Create a league from a hand-entered roster (works for any platform).

get.description: Roster with projections, ROS value, market value, flags and grades vs the league.
Players the market undervalues vs our projection (buy), and your overvalued ones (sell).

Top 10 per position by schedule-adjusted points, for each upcoming week and the rest of
the season (all players; owner labeled).
Ranked advisor feed (Trade / Sell / Buy / Waiver / Lineup / Bye prep) + team grades.
TD over expected, efficiency outliers and usage/production mismatches.
Week × lineup-slot grid of remaining byes with danger weeks.

put.description: Edit a manual team: name, scoring, league size, lineup/bench/IR depth and players.

post.description: Score a trade by its effect on both teams' rest-of-season starting lineups.

get.description: 1-for-1 and 2-for-1 ideas where both lineups gain (hidden after the trade deadline).

post.description: Re-pull league rosters/transactions (scope=league), market values, or everything.

get.description: Player search (used by manual team entry). Full players table arrives in phase 3.

has_market.title: Has Market
has_market.description: False when the market doesn't value this position

buy.title: Buy
buy.description: Undervalued players on other teams / free agents

market_implied_points.title: Market Implied Points
market_implied_points.description: ROS points of the player we rank where the market ranks him

scoring_preset.title: Scoring Preset
scoring_preset.description: Preset key when the rules match one exactly

roster_positions.title: Roster Positions
roster_positions.description: Starting slots plus one 'BN' per bench spot and one 'IR' per IR spot (bench depth varies by league).

player_ids.title: Player Ids
player_ids.description: Everyone on the roster (starters, bench and IR)

starters.title: Starters
starters.description: Subset of player_ids in the starting lineup; must fit the starting slots. Empty = we pick the best lineup.

ir.title: Ir
ir.description: Subset of player_ids stashed on IR

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True when using a fallback source or another format

index.title: Index
index.description: Opponent's fantasy points allowed to the position vs average (>1 easier)

z.title: Z
z.description: Standard deviations above the comparison-league average

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: How strongly matchups move this position (0 = not at all)

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team name, 'Free agent', or None if unknown

points.title: Points
points.description: Matchup-adjusted projected points (week or rest of season)

neutral_points.title: Neutral Points
neutral_points.description: Same projection against an average schedule

schedule_delta.title: Schedule Delta
schedule_delta.description: points - neutral_points: what the schedule adds

cells.title: Cells
cells.description: Weekly view: that week; ROS: next few opponents

ppg.title: Ppg
ppg.description: Projected fantasy points per game (league scoring)

signal.title: Signal
signal.description: Our projection vs the market: one verdict used everywhere

value_gap.title: Value Gap
value_gap.description: Model ROS points minus what the market's price implies

slot.title: Slot
slot.description: Platform slot: starter | bench | ir | taxi

grade_basis.title: Grade Basis
grade_basis.description: What the grades are compared against

partner.description: Null for a hypothetical trade with players not on a league roster
